stem: Which woman fought to create legislation to help the people described in this excerpt?
visual_elements: I found, near Boston, in the jails and asylums for the poor, a numerous class brought into unsuitable connection with criminals and the general mass of paupers. I refer to . . . insane persons, dwelling in circumstances not only adverse to their own physical and moral improvement, but productive of extreme disadvantages to all other persons brought into association with them. —Memorial to the Legislature of Massachusetts, 1843
